## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always use db-stg-2; db-stg-1 is decommissioned and `config/staging.yaml` is stale.

Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination work is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` doubled ingest-path write latency.

## Recent work
Completed SQLAlchemy modernization: timezone-aware timestamps, injected billing sessions, explicit imports, legacy-free pagination, and FastAPI dependency annotations. Full lint passed; tests passed (149 passed, 2 skipped). Replaced an invoice-creation `print()` with structured logging and verified invoice API tests (11 passed). Request-ID middleware support was located. Next, inspect and test Stripe signature verification.
